ios-forms|Digit entry views.summary: On iOS the Plenix PIN / OTP input is not the tvOS digit entry view: it is one system text field, kept native in behavior (the number pad, the one-time code from Messages offered above the keyboard, paste, VoiceOver reading the code as one value), drawn as a row of square Plenix boxes, one per digit. Each box is 44 points square in the Plenix field roles (the control surface, the control border, the 6-point control corners), the digits in Reddit Mono, and the box that takes the next digit shows the focus color on its border. A sensitive PIN shows dots.

anatomy.name: Box
anatomy.about: One square per digit, 44 points, in the Plenix control surface with the control border and corners.

anatomy.name: Digit

anatomy.name: Next box
anatomy.about: The box the next digit goes into: its border in the focus color, never a ring outside it.

anatomy.name: Field
anatomy.about: One system text field under the boxes holds the code, so autofill, paste and VoiceOver work on the whole code.
